name: Generate a proposal then preserve editable commercial structure
description: Verifies invalid client contact data is blocked, then proposal generation remains central while sellers can persist connected scope relationships without silently treating downstream guidance as current or sharing stale commercial evidence.
steps: Create a client with an email containing whitespace and confirm the validation error, then save the client with a valid email
Generate a proposal from a realistic client brief for that saved client
Open Editable Scope Graph and add connected requirement, deliverable and task nodes
Save the graph and attempt to create a client proposal share
Refresh and reopen the opportunity
expected: The malformed client email is rejected and not persisted; the valid client, proposal and scope graph persist; ScopeVanta indicates downstream commercial/proposal guidance needs recalculation; and client sharing is blocked until stale evidence/commercial guidance is reconciled.

name: Preserve baseline and approved change-order history
description: Verifies commercial commitments are preserved as history rather than overwritten by the latest state.
steps: Open an opportunity with Opportunity Lab intelligence and save its proposal without changing the proposal text; confirm the revision number does not advance
Change the proposal text, save it, and confirm exactly one prior proposal revision is preserved
Establish a baseline, assess an out-of-scope client request, record the approved change order, and establish a later baseline
Open proposal revision history and Durable commercial history
expected: An unchanged proposal save creates no phantom revision; a real proposal edit advances exactly one version and preserves the prior text; multiple baseline versions and the approved change-order record remain visible with their proposal/baseline context.

name: Let a buyer select a package and record real engagement
description: Verifies Deal Room engagement records actual views and package selection without inferring buyer intent.
steps: Share a proposal that has commercial scenarios
As the buyer open the shared proposal and select one available package
Return as the seller and reopen the opportunity
Inspect Deal Room engagement
expected: The selected package, actual proposal view count and last-view time are visible to the seller, while proposal acceptance remains a separate explicit buyer decision.

name: Collect discovery answers through a client link
description: Verifies discovery questions can be sent to a buyer and returned answers become durable opportunity evidence.
steps: Run Discovery Agent for an opportunity and create the client discovery link
As the client open the link on mobile
Enter name, email and at least one answer and submit
As the seller reopen the opportunity
expected: The submitted discovery answers are stored on the opportunity and the seller is prompted to review them before refining the proposal.

name: Show exact billing lifecycle and prevent duplicate subscription checkout
covers: exact trial end and charged-through state
description: Verifies Plan & billing presents the persisted Square lifecycle precisely and does not start a second checkout for a workspace that already has a verified active Square subscription.
steps: Open Plan & billing for an account with a verified active Square subscription
Attempt to switch plans from the pricing cards
Confirm no second Square checkout opens
Open Plan & billing for a non-active lifecycle and inspect Entitlement Audit and recovery guidance
expected: An already-active workspace does not open another Square checkout; lifecycle, trial end, charged-through date, required action and last Square event remain visible, with payment-failed, canceled and paused states retaining distinct recovery guidance.
